newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firm with futures, tight supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm with futures, tight supply.

text.p: NWE oil products were firm on stronger futures and tightness of supply in many sectors.
Gasoline was firmer. At least 300,000 tonnes of September- loading gasoline is due to sail transatlantic.
Naphtha was firmer. A small paraffinic cargo was heard traded at $210 cif ARA.
High sulphur barges were steady, trading around $111-112 fob ARA, but activity was slower.
Gas oil was firm. The barge market was the focus of most activity with premiums assessed at Oct +$8/+$10 fob ARA.
